hyperedges.label: Edit to render flow: adjustment model + looks + masks feed the WebGL pipeline
Glass design language for floating controls

nodes.label: Backup .lumora file format (LUMORABK1)
nodes.rationale: Magic header, 4-byte length, JSON manifest, then photo blobs; restore only adds what is missing.

nodes.label: Looks catalogue (built-in presets + 12x12 categories)
nodes.rationale: Looks are added on top of the photo own adjustments, scaled by Amount; ids stable from 1.x.

nodes.label: Motion tokens (spring, bounce, reduced motion)
nodes.rationale: iOS sheet-like settle; durations zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Bottom sheet and scrim system
nodes.rationale: Sheets rise in, dismiss by drag or tap outside; focus trapped inside and background made inert.

nodes.label: Editor top bar (back, compare, undo/redo, favourite, more, export)
nodes.norm_label: editor top bar (back, compare, undo/redo, favourite, more, export)

nodes.label: Icon system (24pt grid, 1.75 stroke, ICONS map)
nodes.norm_label: icon system (24pt grid, 1.75 stroke, icons map)

nodes.label: Short-landscape side-column layout
nodes.rationale: Tools move to a side column so the photo keeps its height.

nodes.label: Storage layer (IndexedDB with memory fallback)
nodes.rationale: Internal DB name revelado kept from before the rename so saved photos stay; falls back to memory and warns when volatile.

nodes.label: Design tokens (Obsidian, Graphite, Pearl White, Aurora Violet, Icy Blue)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (obsidian, graphite, pearl white, aurora violet, icy blue)
nodes.rationale: Guided by Apple HIG; aurora gradient reserved for active/primary elements (ruler needle, value rings, selected look, main action).

nodes.label: i18n string tables (STR es/en)
nodes.rationale: English everywhere unless Spanish is chosen in Settings.

nodes.label: Library large-title bar (#libBar)
nodes.rationale: iOS large title: compact glass bar takes over once the wordmark scrolls away.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass material (.glass)
nodes.rationale: Glass only for floating controls, never stacked on glass, so the photo stays first; solid fallback for Reduce Transparency, high contrast and no backdrop-filter.

nodes.label: PWA (manifest, home-screen meta, service worker)
nodes.rationale: Works offline after Add to Home Screen; SW registered only on https.

nodes.label: Export sheet (preview, resolution, size estimate, quality, Share)
nodes.norm_label: export sheet (preview, resolution, size estimate, quality, share)

nodes.label: Editor gestures (pinch, double-tap, pan, hold to compare, swipe)
nodes.norm_label: editor gestures (pinch, double-tap, pan, hold to compare, swipe)
nodes.rationale: Each gesture has a visible button equivalent (compare, zoom chip, tool row) for discoverability.

nodes.label: English default, Spanish option, light/dark, Reduce Motion/Transparency
nodes.norm_label: english default, spanish option, light/dark, reduce motion/transparency
nodes.rationale: English by default on every device; accessibility preferences respected.

nodes.label: Lumora (private photo editor)
nodes.rationale: A personal photo editor for iPhone that runs in Safari: JPG/PNG/HEIC in, JPG out. No account, no cloud: photos and edits stay on the device. Tagline: Light. Tone. Precision.

nodes.label: Precision ruler
nodes.rationale: Snap to zero, 5x fine mode, double-tap reset, edited span, tap number to type an exact value.

nodes.label: Before/after split view
nodes.rationale: Draggable divider drawn per pixel on the GPU.

nodes.label: IndexedDB database revelado (v2)
nodes.rationale: Storage unchanged and backward compatible: photos, edits, presets stores; 2.0 only adds optional favorite field.

nodes.label: Lumora 2.0
nodes.rationale: Full-screen editor with floating glass controls so the photo stays first; every gesture also has a visible button.

nodes.label: On-device privacy (no account, no cloud, no AI service)
nodes.norm_label: on-device privacy (no account, no cloud, no ai service)
nodes.rationale: Everything runs in Safari on the device; deliberately excludes cloud sync, video, RAW and generative fill.

nodes.label: Mask edit pane (overlay, erase, invert, delete)
nodes.norm_label: mask edit pane (overlay, erase, invert, delete)

nodes.label: Auto adjustment analysis
nodes.rationale: Own on-device analysis: exposure to middle grey, then tone from luminance spread; tap again to undo.

nodes.label: Export pipeline (JPG, size, quality, share)
nodes.rationale: Re-renders from the original at up to 16 MP; no location or camera metadata written.

nodes.label: WebGL2 GPU editing pipeline (fragment shader)
nodes.rationale: sRGB to linear, white balance, exposure, contrast, tone, vibrance, saturation, effects, mixer, grading, masks; split view decided per pixel in screen space.

nodes.label: 154 looks in 13 categories, Recommended looks, Quick Actions
nodes.norm_label: 154 looks in 13 categories, recommended looks, quick actions

nodes.label: Preview/export memory limits (2048 px preview, 16 MP export)
nodes.norm_label: preview/export memory limits (2048 px preview, 16 mp export)
nodes.rationale: Edit on a reduced copy because of Safari memory limits; iOS canvas ceiling about 16.7 MP.

nodes.label: Adjustment model (SLIDERS, DEFAULTS)
nodes.rationale: Every value is 0 when untouched, and 0 renders exactly as before.

nodes.label: Remove / heal spots
nodes.rationale: Each spot filled from a matched nearby patch with colour shift, applied before adjustments.

nodes.label: Mask system (brush/linear/radial rasterised to RGBA texture)
nodes.norm_label: mask system (brush/linear/radial rasterised to rgba texture)
nodes.rationale: Geometry in image coordinates so one mask fits preview, thumbnails and full-size export.

nodes.label: Backup and restore (.lumora file)
nodes.rationale: One file with photos, edits, favourites and looks saved wherever the user chooses; no upload.

nodes.label: Effects (clarity, texture, dehaze, vignette, grain, sharpening, noise, lens corrections, Lens Blur)
nodes.norm_label: effects (clarity, texture, dehaze, vignette, grain, sharpening, noise, lens corrections, lens blur)

nodes.label: Masks (brush, linear, radial; up to 4) and Remove
nodes.norm_label: masks (brush, linear, radial; up to 4) and remove

nodes.label: Lumora 2.1: premium tools on device
nodes.rationale: Adds effects, colour mixer/grading, masks, Remove, 154 looks and backup, all computed locally.

nodes.label: Editor tab bar (Light, Color, Effects, Masks, Looks, Crop)
nodes.norm_label: editor tab bar (light, color, effects, masks, looks, crop)

nodes.label: Mask paint canvas and handle SVG (#paintCv, #maskSvg)
nodes.norm_label: mask paint canvas and handle svg (#paintcv, #masksvg)

nodes.label: Zoom, pan, hold-to-compare and swipe gestures
nodes.norm_label: zoom, pan, hold-to-compare and swipe gestures

nodes.label: Crop tools (rotate, flip, aspect chips, reset)
nodes.norm_label: crop tools (rotate, flip, aspect chips, reset)
